messages.text: How do I transfer my 7,200,000 bolts to the bots store. I hit the jackpot and went to the bolt store to redeem, but my bolts aren't there.
Searched the web · bolts jackpot "bolt store" bots store redeem
Searched the web · heliumdeploy harlo pool bolts
Handed to the team · Hal cannot see Harlo Pool accounts or Bolt balances; jackpot credit needs someon

Hi, I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Congratulations on the jackpot!

You shouldn't need to transfer anything. Bolts 
stack up in your pool account until you spend them in the Bolts store
. So if the store isn't showing them, it's usually because the store is looking at a different account from the one that won.

Please check this:

1. Log in at pool.harlolabs.com with the same email you used for the pool account that won the spin. If you have more than one email, try each one.
2. Look at your Bolt balance on the pool site first, then open the Bolts store from there.

I can't see Harlo Pool accounts or Bolt balances myself, so I've also passed this to the team so they can check that the jackpot was credited to your account. They're offline now and will pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET. Their answer will come to your email.

In the meantime, let me know what balance the pool site shows after you log in.

Thanks. So the pool site shows 14,536 Bolts, which is far short of the 7,200,000 you saw when you won.

I can't see your spin history or how the jackpot was credited, so I won't guess what caused the gap. The team already has your case. To help them check it, please send:

1. A screenshot of the winning spin, or of your spin history showing the 7,200,000 win, if the pool site has one.
2. Roughly when you won (date and time).

The team will pick this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and their answer will come to your email.
Here is a screenshot of my Bolts:

Thanks for the screenshot. Unfortunately I don't think that 7,200,000 is your balance.

Your screenshot is of the Harlo Pool information page on heliumdeploy.com, the one titled "Stack Bolts. Take home a miner." The same page also has our chat window open. It isn't your pool account. The big "YOUR BOLTS 7,200,000" counter there looks like a sample display that shows how the rewards work, which is why every prize up to the Harlo B30 shows as unlocked. It isn't tied to your login.

Your real balance is the one on pool.harlolabs.com when you're logged in, which you said is 14,536 Bolts. That's what the Bolts store uses.

I know that's not the news you were hoping for. I can't see pool accounts, so the team is still checking your balance and spin history to confirm it. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you their answer.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks. This screenshot is from the same Harlo Pool information page on heliumdeploy.com. It has the "The lottery, in your pool" heading and the "Start mining on Harlo Pool" button, and the slot machine there shows "+4,377 Bolts".

That slot machine looks like a try-it demo on the information page, like the 7,200,000 counter. As far as I can tell, wins there don't go into your pool account. Your real free spins and Bolts are on pool.harlolabs.com when you're logged in:

1. You get a spin credit every 4 hours once one miner has held 800 GH/s for a full hour.
2. You spin on the pool site, and those winnings add to the 14,536 balance you saw there.
3. You redeem from that balance in the Bolts store.

I can't see your pool account, so the team is still checking your balance and spin history to confirm. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you their answer.
So the free spin on this page is bogus?  Hit a jackpot and win nothing?
Handed to the team · Customer feels misled by the spin widget on /pages/harlo-pool. Hal cannot confir

I understand why you're frustrated. The page says "FREE SPIN READY", you hit a jackpot and the counter showed 7,200,000 Bolts. Anyone would take that as a real win.

As far as I can tell, the spin on that page is a demo that shows how the game works, and it isn't connected to your pool account. That's why your real balance on pool.harlolabs.com is still 14,536. If the page doesn't make that clear, that's on us, not you.

I can't confirm how that page works or change anything on your account, and I won't promise you an outcome I can't deliver. I've passed the team the full picture: the page you were on, the jackpot it showed, your real balance and that the page misled you. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you their answer.

Your real spins still count. Every 4 hours of mining on Harlo Pool earns you a free spin on pool.harlolabs.com, and anything you win there goes into your real balance.
